invariants.rationale: The method is expected to return a non-null list, since it is a filtered version of recordsWithLocation.
The method should not be called with null input lists, ensuring safe processing.
The returned list is created by filtering recordsWithLocation to contain only those where isCurrentLocationKnown() is false.
Filtering hoodieRecords can only keep the same or fewer records, never more.
All elements of result must come from the original input hoodieRecords list, since it is ultimately a filtered sublist.
